description: §51.0.F.1 (S479): a literal engine write OUTSIDE any state-child body — `function load() { @phase = .Loading; }`, the canonical §66 function-body idiom — does NOT fire W-ENGINE-SELF-WRITE-DETECTED. The CONSERVATIVE outside-state-child firing is struck; only the STRICT inside-state-child half remains (engine-self-write-pos). Two clicks drive the engine Idle -> Loading -> Done through the function bodies. XFAIL on impl#1: it still emits the struck outside firing (compiler/src/symbol-table.ts walkEngineSelfWriteOutside) — a carried divergence (S471 policy).
rationale: §51.0.F.1 (S479): "Outside any state-child body (function bodies, top-level logic, event handlers not attached to engine state-children) the lint does NOT fire." ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — the rest of S478 hand-off §3.B, PA recs adopted" item 7 — "drop the conservative firing outside a state-child (§51.0.F.1); keep the strict inside-state-child half. Under §66 a function-body engine write is the canonical idiom."
